coverage_limits: No MathSciNet subscription was used; zbMATH Open, Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv, and public author pages provide the public metadata layer.
OpenAlex citation edges are incomplete and sometimes split preprint/version-of-record nodes.
Publisher PDFs blocked by access controls are listed in sources.json; no credentials were used.
Private manuscripts, unindexed repositories, non-English sources not surfaced by these queries, and items posted after the cutoff are outside coverage.
Competing full-proof titles were not accepted at face value: Scandone is author-marked erroneous; Demontis and Schrader remain unadjudicated in this audit and outside the entropy/coupling route.
cutoff: Sources and versions public by 2026-08-25 local date; APIs queried at the UTC date boundary may show 2026-08-26 timestamps.

protocol_steps.review: Titles and abstracts screened; entropy, coupling, explicit-constant, computer-assisted, formalization, and competing full-proof claims opened at theorem level where relevant.
Latest versions, dates, comments, journal references, DOIs, PDFs, and source bundles checked.

protocol_steps.note: Very noisy relevance ranking; used only to find publication/DOI records, not as an exhaustive theorem search.
Noisy substring search; relevant combinatorics records inspected.

protocol_steps.query: cites:<work-id> for each core arXiv/published record
protocol_steps.review: All returned citing records through the cutoff saved in citation_graph.json; arXiv/published duplicates queried separately.

protocol_steps.query: arXiv identifier, exact title, or DOI for each core work
protocol_steps.review: Public bibliographic records saved in sources.json; editorial text may be license-limited.
Repository commits pinned; cited computation files downloaded where accessible.

protocol_steps.index: Exact phrase and theorem-concept web search
